target_customer: Financial services firms such as RIAs, wealth tech and banks with back-office compliance and operations work
problem: Back-office work like KYC reviews, transaction alerts and disputes is done by humans on screens without APIs. Zomma deploys computer-use agents that work on the same screens, tested on private benchmarks of the customer's past cases, with human final review.
business_model: Agent fleets sold as an AI BPO, pricing not stated
product_category: AI operations workforce, computer-use agents for financial services

founders.name: Jihyun Kim
prior_employers: Hedge fund described as Blackstone-backed (founding team and Head of Product)

competitors.what: Specialist AI agents for customer operations in financial services

technical_complexity.rationale: Reliable computer-use agents in regulated workflows need strong accuracy, evaluation harnesses and auditability; the company reports 92% on OSWorld (company claim).

defensibility.rationale: Agents rely on frontier models available to all; customer-specific benchmarks and audit evidence and SOC 2 create some lock-in.

market_need_then: Banks are outsourcing KYC and compliance and only about 10 percent of financial institutions had deployed AI agents at scale per Capgemini research cited in trade press; alert triage false positive rates are very high.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, plain and trust-focused, for example AI agents for operations that can't fail

brand_strength.rationale: Invented name close to other Z names and misspellings such as Zomato, no brand evidence found.

outcome_analysis: Zomma joined YC in Summer 2026 with three founders from finance and applied AI and says it is piloting with a US RIA and a $10B AUM wealth tech. No outcome yet. The risk is competition from other finance agent startups and model improvements that commoditize agents.
notes: Caplight lists only a Y Combinator accelerator round dated 2026-06-05 with no amount; not recorded as a round. Competitor search for the batch period found only broad market context, so the two listed are neighbors found via funding searches. Outcome search found no news about Zomma.
